This small plot of 0.08 hectares is just a little piece near my compound, so I will manage it simply with what I have. Since it is "other" crop and not my main field, I will not waste money on chemical fertilizer or improved seed — I will use the seed I saved myself and put some manure from my goats and chickens on it. I have no money for pesticide and no way to irrigate, so I will just rely on the rain and my own hands, with maybe one day of help from my brother during weeding.
